SECRET

PP.66074/B.1.C/1RS.

31 October 1950.

Further to my letter of 27 September 1950 about John OLDAY, alias William Arthur OLDAG, his present address is now 284, Tavistock Road, W.11.

I have tried to obtain information about his correspondents in Belgium, but without success.

Yours sincerely,

M. Sercombe.

S.I.S.

MRS/AGB.

SECRET

THIS IS A COPY
ORIGINAL DOCUMENT RETAINED
IN DEPARTMENT UNDER SECTION
3(4) OF THE PUBLIC RECORDS
ACT 1958
